00246 inline float wrap(float in, float lo, float hi) throw()
00247 {
00248     float range;
00249     if (in >= hi) 
00250     {
00251         range = hi - lo;
00252         in -= range;
00253         if (in < hi) return in;
00254     } 
00255     else if (in < lo) 
00256     {
00257         range = hi - lo;
00258         in += range;
00259         if (in >= lo) return in;
00260     } 
00261     else return in;
00262     
00263     if (hi == lo) return lo;
00264     return in - range * std::floor((in - lo)/range); 
00265 }

00294 inline float fold(float in, float lo, float hi) throw() 
00295 {
00296     float x;
00297     float c, range, range2;
00298     x = in - lo;
00299     
00300     if (in >= hi) 
00301     {
00302         in = hi + hi - in;
00303         if (in >= lo) return in;
00304     } 
00305     else if (in < lo) 
00306     {
00307         in = lo + lo - in;
00308         if (in < hi) return in;
00309     } 
00310     else return in;
00311     
00312     if (hi == lo) return lo;
00313 
00314     range = hi - lo;
00315     range2 = range + range;
00316     c = x - range2 * std::floor(x / range2);
00317     if (c>=range) c = range2 - c;
00318     return c + lo;
00319 }

00406 inline float linlin(const float input, 
00407                     const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00408                     const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00409 {
00410     float inRange = inHigh - inLow;

00412     return (input - inLow) * outRange / inRange + outLow;

00434 inline float linsin(const float input, 
00435                     const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00436                     const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00437 {
00438     float inRange = inHigh - inLow;
00439     float outRange = outHigh - outLow;
00440         
00441     float inPhase = (input - inLow) * pi / inRange + pi;
00442     float cosInPhase = (float)std::cos((double)inPhase) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00443     
00444     return cosInPhase * outRange + outLow;  
00445 }

00472 inline float linexp(const float input, 
00473                     const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00474                     const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00475 {
00476     float outRatio = outHigh / outLow;
00477     float reciprocalInRange = 1.f / (inHigh - inLow);
00478     float negInLowOverInRange = reciprocalInRange * -inLow;
00479     return outLow * pow(outRatio, input * reciprocalInRange + negInLowOverInRange); 
00480 }

00500 inline float linwelch(const float input, 
00501                       const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00502                       const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00503 {
00504     float inRange = inHigh - inLow;
00505     float outRange = outHigh - outLow;
00506     float inPos = (input - inLow) / inRange;
00507 
00508     if (outLow < outHigh)
00509         return outLow + outRange * std::sin(piOverTwo * inPos);
00510     else
00511         return outHigh - outRange * std::sin(piOverTwo - piOverTwo * inPos);
00512     
00513 }
